batches.purpose: Port the smallest Flatpak substrate after Podman without accepting donor /usr, /lib, /bin, /etc, or /var paths as AUZiX root authority.

packages.notes: Sandbox helper. First proof must run /Programs/Bubblewrap/current/Commands/bwrap --version without requiring /usr/bin/bwrap.
Content-addressed backing store lives under /System/State/ostree; commands project through /Programs/OSTree/current/Commands.
Portal/dbus boundary helper. Keep runtime sockets under /run and AUZiX service state, not donor /var paths.
System installation state belongs under /System/State/flatpak and settings under /System/Settings/flatpak. No app is considered integrated until it has a /Programs/<App>/current adapter.

batches.purpose: Expose one Flatpak application as a normal AUZiX program without making root-level compatibility links part of the base image.

packages.notes: Prototype /Programs/Firefox/current/Commands/firefox adapter that invokes Flatpak through AUZiX paths. The adapter may use /System/Compatibility only when the receipt marks it as break-fix debt.
